reported.quote: Deposits increased 18.8% year-on-year on a reported basis, including a 4 percentage point lift from special FCNR (B) window.
As you will see in our published deck, CASA grew at about 10.8% on an overall basis.
And within this, retail CASA growth was about 11.2% year-on-year compared to 9% a year ago, reflecting improving momentum.
We added about 1.7 million liability relationships in the second quarter, which is 25% higher than Q1 and 33% higher than the fourth quarter of last year.
Total AUM grew 15.3% year-on-year, including a 1.9% impact of FCNR (B) leverage, with SME and retail assets leading the charge.
The pace of retail disbursements is accelerating and has crossed Rs 90,000 crores during Q2 FY27 as against Rs 76,000 crores in Q1 of this year.

reported.metric: Retail assets ex agri annual growth
reported.quote: September'26 annual growth is about 11.2% compared to 9.1% as of June'26 and 7.4% as of March'26.
New credit card issuances at 1.4 million have grown by nearly 19% quarter-on-quarter, indicating the expansion of the growth runway.

reported.metric: MSME and mid-market EOP loan growth
reported.quote: September'26 EOP loan growth has grown 23.5% year-on-year compared to 17% to 18% year-on-year growth levels seen in the last few quarters.
Our asset quality remains pristine, with GNPA at 1.11%, 13 basis points lower than year-on-year.
Credit costs remain low at 44 basis points, the risk weights to total assets at 69%.
The bank's well-balanced performance translated to ROA of 1.8%, which has been the range that we've been there for a very long time, and quarterly PAT of Rs 19.5 billion
and quarterly PAT of Rs 19.5 billion, which is a growth of 12.7% approximately if you exclude the trading gains.

quarter_margin.name: NIM
quarter_margin.quote: So, firstly, with respect to margins, again, margins are down to 3.32.
